title: Ranking vs. Assignment: The Metric Mismatch in Multi-View Object Association
abstract: arXiv:2606.02022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-view object association is an important computer vision problem that underlies many multi-camera perception tasks. While this task is naturally formulated as a constrained one-to-one matching problem, recent works heavily rely on pairwise ranking metrics like AP and FPR-95 for model evaluation. We highlight a fundamental mismatch between these metrics and the actual assignment objective. Theoretically, we show that AP and FPR-95 can be imperfect even when the assignment is already correct, and that Sinkhorn-based normalization can make them perfect. Conversely, optimal pairwise ranking can still lead to incorrect assignments. We validate this mismatch in practice by using our Sinkhorn-based normalization as a controlled post-processing stress test. translated_title: 排名与分配：多视角对象关联中的度量不匹配
translated_abstract: 多视角对象关联是一个重要的计算机视觉问题，它支撑着许多多摄像头感知任务。虽然这个任务自然地被表述为一个约束的一对一匹配问题，但最近的研究在模型评估中严重依赖像AP和FPR-95这样的成对排名度量。我们强调了这些度量与实际分配目标之间的根本性不匹配。理论上，我们证明即使分配已经正确，AP和FPR-95也可能不完美，而基于Sinkhorn的归一化可以使它们变得完美。相反，最优的成对排名仍可能导致错误的分配。我们通过使用我们的基于Sinkhorn的归一化作为受控的后处理压力测试，在实践中验证了这种不匹配。我们表明，仅优化几个后处理参数就能显著提升AP和FPR-95，而无需在分配级度量（如ACC）上取得相应的改进。
tldr: 本文揭示了多视角对象关联中排名度量（如AP和FPR-95）与分配目标之间的不匹配，并提出使用Sinkhorn归一化作为后处理手段来改善排名度量，而无需提升分配准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the mismatch between ranking metrics (like AP and FPR-95) and the assignment objective in multi-view object association, and proposes Sinkhorn-based normalization as a post-processing step to improve ranking metrics without corresponding gains in assignment accuracy.
